name: Books of Mathematics and Magic
description: A stack of three leather-bound textbooks, their covers embossed with geometric patterns and astral symbols. The pages are filled with dense theorems and mystical incantations.

params.message: The books are surprisingly heavy, as if containing more than just paper and ink.
You decipher a passage linking prime numbers to planar geometry. For a moment, the candlelight flickers and the room feels subtly… larger.
